name: Rise of the Witches of Sin & Primordial Witch Factors
description: Seven individuals awaken the primordial Witch Factors, commanding transcendent Authorities that defy natural magic and reason.

name: Creation of the Three Great Mabeasts
description: Daphne, the Witch of Gluttony, creates the White Whale, the Great Rabbit, and the Black Snake with the ironic intent to end famine across the world.

name: Alliance of the Three Legendary Heroes
description: Sage Flugel, the first Sword Saint Reid Astrea, and the Divine Dragon Volcanica form an unbreakable triumvirate to preserve order and counter rising catastrophic threats.

name: Founding of the Sanctuary & Creation of Beatrice
description: Echidna constructs the Sanctuary barrier, initiates artificial spirit creation yielding Beatrice and Puck, and pursues immortality through Ryuzu Meyer clones.

name: The Melancholy Incursion: Hector Strikes Sanctuary
description: Hector, the Warlock of Melancholy, attacks the Sanctuary using crushing gravitational authorities, forcing Ryuzu Meyer's self-sacrifice to power the defensive barrier.

name: Minerva's Fist of Wrath & Global Calamities
description: Minerva travels the continents punching and instantaneously healing all wounded mortals, unaware that her distorted authority siphons mana elsewhere and triggers violent natural disasters.

name: Carmilla's Unintentional Kingdom Ruin
description: Carmilla the Witch of Lust flees her home kingdom; her overwhelming Authority of faceless adoration drives an entire nation of citizens to forget to breathe or eat in her presence.

name: Sekhmet's Duel at the Great Waterfall
description: Sekhmet the Witch of Sloth battles Volcanica past the rim of the world, effortlessly striking the Divine Dragon past the horizon before falling into an eternal nap.
